text_2.eng:
🏆 Likewise, it’s important to learn to give praise to children!

⭐ It also creates a positive and loving relationship between you and your child.

rows.text_1_facilitator:
⭐ Children who are praised for good behaviour will want to keep behaving well and keep receiving praise. 

4️⃣ Here are 4 simple tips for praising your child.

text_1_facilitator.eng:
⭐ Children who are praised for good behaviour will want to keep behaving well and keep receiving praise. 

4️⃣ Here are 4 simple tips for praising your child.

section_1_text.eng: 👀 Look for anything good or helpful your child does.

section_2_text.eng:
🏆 Praise them and tell them specifically what they have done well.
🎉 Be enthusiastic and really mean it!
🔄 This means they are more likely to do it again.

section_3_text.eng:
🌷 Look for something to praise your child for every day.
🔶 Even if it is something really small, keep doing it.

section_4_text.eng:
💡 Make sure you focus on something your child has done well.
🙂You can show your praise with a big smile or words. You can also clap, hug, or tickle your child to show you appreciate them.
☀️ Keeping it positive reminds your child that you notice them and care.
